description: A diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained recommender through a stable compatibility interface and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
motivation: Support evidence-based model revisions while preserving the RecHarness benchmark, all four Amazon datasets, and the native simulator's recommendation requirements.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Inspect view.model as the actual trained module and adapt probes to any architecture changes. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Use only public interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; unavailable review data and simulator traits must remain unobserved. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Select models using macro-average validation HR@10 across all four categories. Preserve the prescribed splits, seeds, dataset routing, environment-based data directory, and matching predictor architecture.
pseudocode:
Initialize DiagnosisProbe(view, device).
For each diagnostic batch:
  Compute architecture-compatible representations and recommendation scores.
  Accumulate supported measurements using observed data only.
Return {metrics, metric_definitions}.
Build diagnosis_interpreter_prompt from those measurements and definitions, explicitly identifying unavailable information.
Generate unseen-item recommendations for five training users per category.
Evaluate candidate models using the fixed macro validation HR@10 protocol.

originality.positive: Connects architecture-aware diagnostics with a constrained recommendation evaluation workflow.
originality.negative: The description specifies an integration contract, without a new diagnostic algorithm or model.

future_potential.positive: A consistent diagnostic interface can support systematic model revisions and comparisons across architectures.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on probe quality; no improvement in recommendation accuracy is demonstrated.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces, batch structure, and evaluation objective are explicit.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-specific probes, full-catalog recommendation generation, and training–prediction consistency require careful integration.
